---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(
    career_HR = sum(HR),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_max(order_by = career_HR, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  left_join(
    People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    player_name = str_c(nameFirst, nameLast, sep = " "),
    steroid_era = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Active",
      "Not active"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = career_HR,
    y = fct_reorder(player_name, career_HR),
    fill = steroid_era
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Active" = "#D95F02", "Not active" = "#2C7FB8")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Career Home Run Leaders",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    fill = "Active during steroid era",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database"
  )
```

## Barry Bonds

```{r}
Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(home_runs = sum(HR), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs"
  )
```
